cards.text: This is a psalm of David, written for the choirmaster. No warm-up, no small talk. David's very first words are "Help, O LORD," and then he tells the LORD what's wrong.

cards.question: David cries out to the LORD for help. What does he say is wrong?

answers.text: The godly and the faithful have vanished
His enemies have surrounded the city
The rain has stopped across the land

cards.text: And the people still around him? David says they speak with flattering lips and a double heart.

cards.question: David says the people around him speak with flattering lips and a double heart, and they ___ to one another.

cards.text: Flattering lips and lies. That's the coworker who says "GREAT presentation!" to your face, then texts the group chat "that was ROUGH." And David has a word about mouths like that.

cards.question: David asks the LORD to do something to all flattering lips. What is it?

cards.text: Now David lets us hear the smooth talkers for ourselves. And friend... they are CONFIDENT.

cards.question: The smooth talkers in David's psalm brag about how they're going to win. What do they say they'll win with?
The smooth talkers in David's psalm say they answer to the LORD.

cards.text: The smooth talkers say, "We own our lips—who can be our master?" I said "NOBODY tells me what to do" one time, and then the oven timer went off, and friend, I RAN.
Then the psalm takes a turn. Somebody new has something to say.

cards.question: Right in the middle of David's psalm, the LORD Himself speaks up.
The LORD says He will now arise. Who does He say He'll arise for?

cards.text: The LORD promises, "I will bring safety to him who yearns." Then David turns to the LORD's words, and says they're like silver refined in a furnace, like gold purified sevenfold.

cards.question: David says the words of the LORD are ___, like silver refined in a furnace.

cards.text: Flawless, like gold purified SEVENFOLD. I put ONE batch back in for a second round once, and friend, it came out as charcoal.

cards.question: Right after praising the LORD's flawless words, David talks straight to the LORD about this generation. What does David say the LORD will do?

answers.text: Keep us and guard us forever
Send us off to the mountains

cards.question: In the last line of his psalm, David says the wicked have all been driven away.

cards.text: David ends his psalm right there: "The wicked wander freely, and vileness is exalted among men."
